title: maint.event.v1{kind=dlq_dropped}
description: Phase 8 §8.5 / §8.15.9 — notification emitted by maint.dlq.v1 when a replay request is refused for a non-deny / non-escalation reason (rate-limited, malformed, etc.) OR when an operator explicitly drops a DLQ entry via ops.dlq-replay --drop (reason=operator_drop). Operator surface for diagnostic visibility distinct from `dlq_escalated` (request-level) and `dlq_topic_disabled_drained` (topic-level).

target.description: The DLQ topic the entry was dropped from (e.g. predict.vote.dlq).

topic.description: Phase 8 §8.15.9: origin topic (the non-.dlq topic the entry originated from). Present when reason=operator_drop.

dlq_entry_id.description: Phase 8 §8.15.9: stable identifier of the DLQ entry that was dropped. Present when reason=operator_drop.

original_request_id.description: Phase 8 §8.15.9: request_id of the envelope that originally failed and landed in the DLQ. Present when reason=operator_drop.

original_envelope_summary.description: Phase 8 §8.15.9 / §8.15.5: operator-supplied §8.15.5-capped summary of the original envelope. NOT the full envelope (which already lives in the DLQ). Present when reason=operator_drop.

dropped_by.description: Phase 8 §8.15.9: operator key fingerprint / identity that initiated the drop. Present when reason=operator_drop.

drop_reason.description: Phase 8 §8.15.9: operator-supplied free-text reason for the explicit drop. Present when reason=operator_drop.
